Daily: $25 per night for up to 2 people\$10.00 per night for each additional person.
Monthly: $350 per month for one person. $50 per month for each additional person.
The Farm Campground
18-Hole Championship Disc Golf Course
The Farm features a complete 18 hole disc golf course sponsored by Innova Disc Golf. Players will find the course offers a mix of long open fairways, water hazards, technical wooded shots, and uphill and downhill elevation changes. Shots over a pond, hanging baskets and breathtaking views of the Ozark Mountains add to the fun factor, while still offering a challenge to even the most seasoned player. The Greens Fee is $5 for unlimited play for the day.
Course Map Below
We are the official campground of Bikes Blues & BBQ Conveniently located along the ride route, we are only 9 miles from downtown Eureka Springs and 22 miles from Rogers. We offer live music and bike games to keep you entertained during your stay!
Buy your camping or day passes here! Camping passes include full access to all music, entertainment & activities: There are still a few RV sites left, get them now! Day passes: (Wed - Thur = $10.00 per person per day) Day passes: (Fri - Sat = $15.00 per person per day)
